# `shade.set_flat`: Shade flat

Shades faces flat (faceted) by marking all their edges sharp.

- Category: shade
- Version: 1
- Complexity: O(n) for the selector plus O(C) for the faces' corners
- Flags: undoable
- Also known as: shade flat, flat shading, faceted, harden normals

Every edge of the selected faces becomes sharp, so each face shows its own normal; custom normals are dropped. **Use for** faceted low-poly styles (gems, rocks, stylized props).

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `select` | `Selector \| null` | - | Faces to shade; every face when omitted. |
| `target` | `string` | required | Mesh object (name, path or id). |

## Examples

```json
{"target":"post"}
```

Result: `post (o:3): 32 faces shade flat (64 edges sharp)`
